category: Define Security Requirements for Software Development (PO)
subcategory_text: Protect the security requirements from unauthorized access, tampering, and deletion. The integrity and confidentiality of the requirements are critical to ensuring the software is built securely.
implementation_examples: Store security requirements in version-controlled repositories with restricted access
Apply cryptographic integrity checks (e.g., digital signatures) on requirements artefacts
Audit access logs for security requirements files on a defined cadence
assessment_objectives: Determine whether security requirements are protected from unauthorized modification and disclosure.
Determine whether access to security requirements is logged and audited.
